name: Helm of Teleportation

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

text: This helm has 3 charges. While wearing it, you can expend 1 charge to cast Teleport from it. The helm regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn. (The Mists of Barovia hold travellers in the valley: Teleport works only within it.)
